name: kyber1024-implicit-rejection
description: Kyber1024 round-3 decapsulation (type 0x08) of a valid ciphertext and of three ciphertexts with one byte changed, with the given secret key (0x08 || 3168 bytes). For a changed ciphertext, re-encryption does not match and the shared secret is SHAKE256(SHAKE256(z || c, 32) || SHA3-256(c), 32) (CRS-03 section 6.2 rule 6). not_round3_text_form = SHAKE256(z || SHA3-256(c), 32) and not_fips203_rejection = SHAKE256(z || c, 32) are shown for contrast. The oracle has no raw decapsulation, so oracle_session_evidence gives, for each case, a complete version-4 pre-key message whose PQXDH shared secret input uses shared_secret (with the responder keys listed), which the oracle responder decrypted, and for the changed ciphertexts two otherwise identical messages built with the contrast values, which the oracle responder rejected. All private inputs were chosen by the generator.
